entries.proposed: It lit up as someone died next to you. It has used their voice ever since.
entries.text: It lit up as someone died next to you. You took their place.

entries.proposed: You dreamed of it for a year before you ever saw it. The dreams have not stopped.
entries.text: You dreamed of it for a year before you ever saw it.

entries.proposed: It woke the night your home burned. You have never been sure which came first.
entries.text: It fell out of the sky and burned your home.

entries.proposed: It woke during a card game you do not remember playing. You won something.
entries.text: You won it in a game you do not remember playing.

entries.proposed: It woke under a medical scan. Every scan of you since shows it inside your chest.
entries.text: It was inside you. Surgeons removed it.

entries.proposed: It never woke. One day it was simply speaking, and everyone around you acted as if it always had.
entries.text: You have always had it. Everyone else forgot.
A memory. One stat cannot be raised until you recover it in a trial.
A face. Mirrors and cameras show someone else.
A person. Someone you love is inside it. Trials sometimes show them.
Your sleep. Rest removes 1 less Stress.
Your shadow. Things in the dark notice you first.
Nothing yet. It is saving that for later. The TOME may claim a Debt at any Joker.
